properties.name: simba.enabled
properties.description: Whether Simba auto-configuration is enabled.

properties.name: simba.backend
properties.description: Backend to configure: jdbc, redis or zookeeper. Required when more than one backend module is active.

properties.name: simba.session.lease-duration
properties.description: The backend expires the session this long after its last keep-alive; every lease of the session goes with it.

properties.name: simba.session.renew-interval
properties.description: Keep-alive period of the session; at most half of the lease duration. Defaults to a third of it.

properties.name: simba.session.drift
properties.description: Upper bound of the clock rate difference between a node and the backend, in [0, 0.5).

properties.name: simba.session.margin
properties.description: Extra safety subtracted from every local deadline.

properties.name: simba.jdbc.enabled
properties.description: Whether the JDBC backend is enabled.

properties.name: simba.jdbc.dialect
properties.description: Database dialect: mysql or postgresql. Detected from the DataSource when unset.

properties.name: simba.jdbc.query-timeout
properties.description: Per-statement timeout of the JDBC backend. Defaults to the session renew interval.

properties.name: simba.redis.enabled
properties.description: Whether the Redis backend is enabled.

properties.name: simba.redis.wait-replicas
properties.description: When positive, a new term counts only once that many replicas acknowledged it (WAIT). Not on a Redis Cluster.

properties.name: simba.redis.wait-timeout
properties.description: How long WAIT waits for simba.redis.wait-replicas.

properties.name: simba.redis.route-by-slot
properties.description: Whether to split script calls by hash slot. Defaults to true on a Redis Cluster.

properties.name: simba.zookeeper.enabled
properties.description: Whether the Zookeeper backend is enabled.

properties.name: simba.zookeeper.connect-string
properties.description: Zookeeper ensemble the backend opens its sessions on.

properties.name: simba.zookeeper.root
properties.description: Parent path of the lease and group nodes.

properties.name: simba.zookeeper.connection-timeout
properties.description: How long opening a session may wait for the ensemble; defaults to simba.session.renew-interval, after which the engine gives up on the call.

properties.name: simba.zookeeper.auth.scheme
properties.description: Authentication scheme every Zookeeper client adds, e.g. digest.

properties.name: simba.zookeeper.auth.credentials
properties.description: Auth data of the scheme (UTF-8), e.g. user:password for digest. Unset: no authentication.

properties.name: simba.zookeeper.acl
properties.description: ACL of the nodes the backend creates: auto (creator with credentials, else open), open or creator. An ACLProvider bean takes precedence.

properties.name: simba.metrics.enabled
properties.description: Whether Simba records Micrometer metrics when a MeterRegistry bean exists.

properties.name: simba.scheduling.enabled
properties.description: Whether @SimbaScheduled and @SimbaPartitioned methods run with the application context.

values.description: Redis 7 backend over Spring Data Redis.
creator when simba.zookeeper.auth.credentials is set, otherwise open.
